summary: The reopened API refactor now keeps Claude or Codex as the workflow orchestrator and narrows MCP to a read-only status view plus one server-offered semantic transition at a time. The third counter-review accepted that direction but found three remaining design gaps: the source of the human-authored gate summary is unspecified, direct gate-decision application is not available outside the current blocking wrapper, and current phase-implementation status cannot supply the promised exact commit facts. All three findings were accepted with bounded revision plans. The current artifact is not decision-ready until those changes are incorporated. The attempt ceiling was reached because this human-requested redesign entered an already mature review loop at attempt three, not because the issues are unresolvable. I recommend retrying once so the three corrections can be applied and counter-reviewed; choose revise if you want to change the product direction again, or abort to stop this task.
